twoFactorRequired: The BCS team must set up two-step verification before switching customer modules. Set up the authenticator app below.

tenants.title: Customer organizations
tenants.intro: The BCS team sees only the name, code and status of each organization, never the customer's business data.
tenants.forbidden: This page is for active members of the BCS team.
tenants.empty: There are no customer organizations yet. A new organization is created when its contract starts, following the BCS team guide, and then appears here.

modules.title: Modules of {name}
modules.intro: Switch modules only as the contract says. Every change needs a contract reference and a reason; the organization admins will be told, and switching off deletes no data.
modules.coreAlwaysOn: Core is always on and cannot be switched off.
modules.enableHint: The module's menus appear at once for members of this organization who may use them.
modules.disableHint: The module's menus hide and its commands are refused. Existing data stays.
modules.enabled: {name} switched on. The organization admins will be told.
modules.disabled: {name} switched off. The organization admins will be told.

errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.REQUIRES: Switch on {modules} first, then this module.
errors.REQUIRED_BY: These modules still use this one: {modules}. Switch them off first.
errors.OPEN_DOCUMENTS: Documents are still open in this module: {documents}. The customer must close them first.
errors.MODULE_RULES_MISSING: The organization's DOA has no rule for {documentTypes} yet. The customer must publish a DOA with these rules first, then this module can be switched on.
errors.NO_CHANGE: The module is already in this state. Reload the page to see the latest state.
errors.INPUT: Some fields are missing or wrong. Check them and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: This page is for active members of the BCS team. Sign in again and try again.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This organization was not found. Go back to customer organizations and choose again.
errors.FAILED: This could not be saved. Try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has ended. Sign in again, then do this again.
